compare.title: Texture, lines & scars
compare.question: Three common ways to improve skin texture, fine lines and acne scarring.
rows: How it works
Fine needles create controlled micro-channels that prompt your skin to build collagen.
Laser energy removes or heats thin layers of skin, prompting renewal and new collagen.
A professional acid solution exfoliates the skin at a chosen depth.
Often chosen for
Acne scars, enlarged pores, fine lines and overall texture.
Fine lines, uneven texture, sun damage and scarring.
Dullness, uneven tone, mild pigmentation and acne-prone skin.
Sessions
Usually a series, a few weeks apart.
One to several, depending on the depth chosen.
Usually a series; deeper peels are done less often.
Recovery
Redness for a short time is common.
From little to several days, depending on the setting.
From mild flaking to a week of peeling, by depth.
Good to know
Can be combined with PRP or exosomes.
Settings depend on your skin type and tone.
Sun protection before and after matters.

compare.title: Volume & lift
compare.question: How fillers, collagen stimulators and threads differ when the goal is volume or lift.
rows: How it works
Hyaluronic acid gel adds volume where it is placed.
A biostimulator prompts your own collagen over the following months.
Absorbable threads placed under the skin lift and support it.
Often chosen for
Lost volume, folds, lips and under-eye hollows.
Gradual, overall volume and skin quality.
Mild to moderate sagging of the mid face, jowls and neck.
When results show
Right after treatment, settling over about two weeks.
Gradually, over several weeks to months.
A lift right away that continues as collagen builds.
Sessions
Often one, with touch-ups over time.
Usually a few sessions, weeks apart.
One session for most plans.
Good to know
Hyaluronic acid fillers can be dissolved if needed.
Results build slowly by design.
Often combined with fillers or biostimulators.

compare.title: Body contouring
compare.question: Two non-surgical approaches to stubborn fat, compared.
rows: How it works
Controlled cooling of fat cells in the treated area.
Laser energy that heats fat and tightens the skin above it.
Often chosen for
Pinchable fat on the abdomen, flanks, thighs or under the chin.
Fat reduction together with mild skin laxity.
Sessions
One or more per area, depending on the plan.
Usually a short series.
Good to know
Not a weight-loss treatment; best near a stable weight.
Not a weight-loss treatment; results build over weeks.

steps: You meet a member of our medical team at the Uptown or Downtown clinic. There is no charge and no obligation.
We look at your skin, features and health history, and include a VISIA® skin analysis where it helps.
You hear which treatments may suit you, what each involves, the likely number of sessions, risks and costs.
If you go ahead, you get clear preparation steps and sign an informed consent before treatment.
Your treatment is carried out by a trained provider, with written aftercare and a way to reach us.
Where it is useful, we review your progress and adjust the plan. Individual results may vary.
faqs: Which cosmetic treatments does NewDermaMed offer?

Around 50 treatments at our two Toronto clinics: injectables and fillers, collagen stimulators and the APTOS thread lift, laser and light treatments, skin treatments and medical facials, body contouring, hair restoration and vein treatments. Each one has its own page with what it involves.
How do I know which treatment is right for me?

Start with a free consultation. A member of our medical team assesses your skin and goals, often with a VISIA® skin analysis, and explains which options may suit you, what to expect, and the risks and costs. Suitability is always decided in person.
Do I need a consultation before treatment?
Yes. Every treatment begins with a consultation, which is free. It is where your provider checks that a treatment is safe and suitable for you and answers your questions before you decide.
Which treatments have little or no downtime?

Many skin treatments, such as microdermabrasion, light peels and most injectable appointments, let people return to their day soon after, though redness, swelling or bruising can occur. Deeper laser resurfacing and peels need more recovery. Your provider gives you a realistic timeline for your plan.
Are laser treatments suitable for all skin types?

Many are, with the right device and settings, but some lasers carry a higher risk of pigment changes on darker skin tones. Your skin type and history are assessed at your consultation, and settings are chosen for you, or a different option is suggested.
What affects the cost of a treatment?

The treatment, the area, the amount of product and the number of sessions. Current prices and packages are on our pricing page, and your provider confirms the cost of your plan at the consultation before anything is booked.
Yes. Every treatment at NewDermaMed is non-surgical or minimally invasive, from injectables and lasers to the APTOS thread lift and vein treatments.
